content.title: Construction water fill stations
content.summary: Construction water fill stations are available for bulk purchasers, requiring customers to set up a prepaid account at City Hall. Each customer must provide their own hose to use the facilities, which are located at 6701 Indiana Street, 5555 W 56th Avenue, and 6161 Olde Wadsworth Boulevard. For further details, customers can contact the Utilities Department at 720-898-7760.
content.body:
Fill stations are available to provide water to the bulk purchaser conveniently, while maintaining backflow protections for the City's water supply.

Customers are required to set up a **prepaid account**with the City. Accounts can be opened at City Hall, 8101 Ralston Road.

Each water customer must provide a hose for use with the facility in order to avoid freezing and reduce the potential for vandalism.

## Locations

- 6701 Indiana Street (Indiana Shops)
- 5555 w 56th Avenue (Culberston Building)
- 6161 Olde Wadsworth Boulevard (Wadsworth Shops)

## Operations

Stations are equipped with a 2 1/2" hose bib and 3/4" hose bib.

For more information, please contact the Utilities Department at 720-898-7760.
